issues.title: CUDA compiler/runtime qualification tools were initially unavailable
issues.resolution: Blocked checkpoint preserved; CUDA 13.4, nvcc 13.4.59, and Compute Sanitizer 2026.3 later became available and the full native gate passed.

issues.title: Qualification oracle could construct a parent cycle on zero-weight tight edges
issues.resolution: Harness parent construction was replaced with deterministic source-rooted reachability and the zero-weight fixture was rerun.

issues.title: Candidate stale graph-version failure used the wrong taxonomy
issues.resolution: Candidate now emits STALE_GRAPH_VERSION and the failure matrix verifies it.

issues.title: Sanitizer wrapper and native JSON used different output streams
issues.resolution: Qualification tooling safely locates the bounded JSON line while independently inspecting sanitizer diagnostics.

issues.title: Racecheck clean footer differed from generic sanitizer footer
issues.resolution: Tool-specific zero-hazard success parsing was added without accepting warnings or errors.
